purpose: Deterministic validation of weak-face inverse quadratic recovery and a planar separation oracle.
analysis: Report every seed, target type and budget, including failures; exact-oracle numerical upper and simplex-dual lower risk, reference risk, oracle versus independent dense direct-projection check, mixture feasibility, iterations and timing. Validate ray, wedge, complementary weak activation and nonlinear target-mixture examples against analytic formulas. This is a finite-dimensional optimization study, not a comparison of statistical learning algorithms. Numerical roots, projections and enclosing balls use floating point, not verified interval arithmetic.
